authority.purpose: Machine-readable overlay for current repository capability truth

capabilities.remaining: Open-ended synthesis, worker triage/execution, hosted staging integration, proactive escalation, and production rollout remain separately gated.

capabilities.remaining: Run provider-backed adversarial evaluations for each candidate model before claiming model-specific resistance; hosted staging integration and production rollout remain separately gated.

capabilities.summary: Exact candidate assessments and staging handoffs can be projected into immutable platform evidence without granting deployment authority.

capabilities.summary: A disposable end-to-end venue lifecycle and seven failure classes are retained and replayable through production domain paths.

capabilities.summary: Prospect organizations, venues, contacts, opportunities, provenance, research/import, history, follow-up, and reviewed conversion are implemented.
